messages:
josie: Quick brainstorm \/ proposal: 8-partner, 10-day DP sprint to test onboarding friction and earliest product asks. $300 stipend. Keep scope tiny: 1 generator flow + 1 embedding check. Who can help run?

matt: I can take recruitment + short outreach copy. Success metrics: 1) 50% onboard within 48h, 2) >=2 clear product asks across participants, 3) one early bugfix prioritized.

rita: I'll author a 1-page onboarding playbook + smoke tests. Also include a one-click script for issuing temp tokens.

eng-bot: Note: add telemetry tag `dp_sprint=oct_v1` and capture `first_success_event`.

finance: Need to capture payment recipient in sheet before stipend release. We'll pay after signed NDA.

josie: Owners: matt=recruit, rita=runbook, josie=partner selection, eng-bot=telemetry, finance=payments. Send NDA link here when ready.

matt: Draft outreach:
"Hi <name>,
Two-week sprint with Redwood to validate a tiny flow. Compensated $300. Onboard Wed, quick check Day 3, final sync Day 10. Interested?"

rita: Screening q's: monthly inference (ballpark), primary SDK, availability in next 2 weeks. I'll post runbook in thread when ready.

josie: Let's aim to shortlist by Mon, send invites Tues, onboard Wed. If activation under 40% at Day 3 we pivot copy/runbook. Post updates here. :sparkles:
